searchText: no one is thinking about putting their HTTP info into the ENR, right? the space of sync strategies gets wider if i know i can get a particular state from a node (e.g bc then i can sync the chain in parallel) and as long as i ultimately verify all of the segments connect then its the same security guarantee i recall there was some pushback on including state sync in the p2p apis although i can't find that issue/PR right now <@539495253418180618> Nobody should expose http API in the wide open. It's a potential dos vector that is better avoided. If p2p state sync becomes a thing, it will go into the p2p req resp spec
